goal: Research gradient-style text-space optimizers for the skills+plugins control plane via BX and persist a pinned, decision-grade evidence section plus the trace requirements the optimizers imply.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The viable gradient-style optimizer options are identified with pinned identities and mechanisms: SkillOpt, SkillGrad, GEPA, TextGrad, TPGO.
The shared trace requirements are specified as additive run-record deltas (step projections, check-level grader deltas, batch/cluster linkage, harness pins, attribution discipline).
Research-evidence and ROADMAP carry the decision (SkillOpt primary, GEPA for plugin/prompt candidates, SkillGrad momentum experiment, TPGO later) and capsule digests are refreshed; the gate passes.

outcome.summary: Gradient-style optimizer research landed: SkillOpt adapted as the skills-document optimizer, GEPA for plugin-code/prompt candidates with ASI+Pareto, SkillGrad momentum as experiment, TextGrad rejected as dependency, TPGO as the later graph shape; the five trace requirements are documented with the gate green.

what_worked: BX context search surfaced the exact control-plane matches (SkillOpt's skill.md-as-weights and SkillGrad's trajectory-level loss evidence) alongside the already-roadmapped GEPA, now pinned as ICLR 2026 Oral.
The trace requirements fell out of the mechanisms directly (ASI, loss evidence, GRAO error clustering, attribution benchmarks) rather than being guessed.

evidence.summary: New pinned section: five optimizer options with identities and mechanisms, dal-fit analysis, per-source recommendations, and the five trace requirements.
Typecheck, build, 129 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed with the refreshed capsule digests.

uncertainty.statement: Search snippets and abstracts were the evidence base for SkillOpt/SkillGrad/TPGO mechanics; source-level implementation inspection was not performed in this task.
uncertainty.resolution: Before the optimizer adapter is implemented, clone and inspect microsoft/SkillOpt and gepa-ai/gepa at a pinned commit under the research-driven-development deep-dive contract.

notes: Research and documentation only; no optimizer code, model calls, or external transfers were performed.
